name: Make a key sends only a hash, for Reem, labelled, no user_id of its own
the link is shown once: .../functions/v1/share-widget?t=kf_p_ + 43 characters
its SHA-256 is what was sent, the token itself never was
it says it won't be shown again, and Copy is there
Stop this key sets revoked_at on that key only
the key and its link are gone from the screen
nobody connected: no Widgets section, no key to make
Details: Reem, her blocks with titles, her goal and Top 3 count
it carries when it was read (the widget greys out a day later) and no row ids
timed blocks only, still to come or running
Titles: titles and times, no goal, no Top 3
Busy only: every block is Busy (no title), no goal
a pause: her name and when it ends, no blocks, no goal
nobody connected: partner is null (the widget says "Share your day with someone")
before the disconnect the widget has her day
after a disconnect the next refresh writes partner: null, nothing of hers is kept
